implementation.required_scope: Every CLI operation requires one canonical --location-id UUID.
implementation.query_boundary: Sensor UUID/slug lookup, active sensor inventory, and both calibration queries bind the selected location. CSV rows cannot resolve devices outside that location.
implementation.fail_closed_boundary: Missing or malformed scope is rejected before opening a database connection or cursor, including direct run_csv/run_single calls.
implementation.scheduled_source: Recurring sensor ingestion remains rejected until it has an explicit source contract.

limitations: The location argument constrains query selection but is not an authenticated tenant grant.
This does not establish signed worker context, least-privilege database access, or application RLS.
No candidate or legacy database, live device, provider, or persisted schedule was accessed.
